# anthropic_external_key (Data Source)

Reads one customer-managed encryption key registration by id. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_external_key" "example" {
  id = "ekey_01ExampleKeyId00000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) External key id (`ekey_...`).

### Read-Only

- `attachment_type` (String) `attached` or `unattached`.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `geo` (String) Geography.
- `key_name` (String) Key name (gcp, azure).
- `kms_arn` (String) AWS KMS key ARN (aws).
- `provider_type` (String) `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.
- `region` (String) AWS region (aws).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant id (azure).
- `vault_uri` (String) Key Vault URI (azure).
